must_show: a low concave constructed shelf with a dry reachable approach
three visibly different nonhuman material histories that overlap and interlock
one irregular physical trace crossing all three histories and reacting differently in each
receded water kept laterally away from the dry route
must_preserve: silent physical evidence without a world response
avoid: human pipes, cables, clamps, drains, roads, buildings, or machinery
ordinary natural lakebed or geological strata
writing, glyphs, UI, characters, glow, reward, answer, or watermark
